evidence.reason: The finding asks that `--triage-dry-run` combined with `--job`/`--source-sha`/`--finding-sha256` be rejected before `triage_phase()`. Current code does exactly that: selectors are collected at 1544-1547, and lines 1559-1562 refuse `--triage-dry-run` when any selector is supplied (returning exit 2 with a JSON refusal) before the `if args.triage_dry_run:` branch at 1563 and the `triage_phase(config, dry_run=True)` call at 1567. Standalone preview (no selectors) and standalone explicit repair (all three selectors, no dry run) remain valid. History confirms the fix: 3ebf45efc "reject conflicting selectors before the dry-run branch" and merge d1296416 "refuse --triage-dry-run with a job selector".
